title: Kashmir Main Tu Kanyakumari
artist: Vishal-Shekhar, Sunidhi Chauhan, Arijit Singh, Neeti Mohan
rawTtml:
Chipak-chipak Ke Chalatee Hain Kabhi-kabhi Do Raahen

Jude-jude Kuch Aise Ki Lagaa Ho Jaise Gum

Double Double Hotee Thi Jo Kabhi-kabhi Taqalifein

Haan Kisi Ke Sang Mein Chalne Se Huee Half Se Kam

Ho Tera-meraa Meraa-tera

Tera-mera Mera-tera Qissa Atarangi

Kabhi-kabhi Chalatee Hai

Kabhi-kabhi Rukati Kahaani Bedhangi

Kashmir Main Too Kanyakumari

North South Kee Cat Gayi Dekho Doori Hee Saaree

Kashmir Too Main Kanyakumari

50-50 Har Situation Mein Hissedari Hey-hey

Ek Taraf To Jhagada Hai Saath Phir Bhee Tagada Hai

Do Katam Chalte Hain To Lagtaa Hai Aath Hain

Do Tarah Ke Flavor Sau Tarah Ke Tevar

Dar-ba-dar Firte Hain Jee Phir Bhee Afni Thaath Hai

Kabhi-kabhi Chalem Sidhe Kabhi Mud Jaaen

Kabhi-kabhi Kaheen Tooten Kaheen Jud Jaaen

Hum Shaam-o-sahar Ke Chaaron Pehar Ke Mood Mein Dhal Jaaen

Kashmir Main Too Kanyakumari

Uttar Ne Dakshin Ko Afalaatoon Aakhiree Maari

Kashmir Too Main Kanyakumari

Tel Bechney Jae To Phir Ye Duniyaa Saaree

Main Zaraa Sa Puncture To Too Haea Ke Jesee Hai

Saath Hon To Pahie Taqadeeron Ke Tight Ho

Bulb Ban Jaaoon Main Aur Too Switch Ban Jaa

Bhaad Mein Jae Duniyaa Apanee Batti Bright Ho

Kabhi-kabhi Chalem Sidhe Kabhi Mud Jaaen

Kabhi-kabhi Paidal Kabhi Ud Jaaen

Hamein Dekh Jamaane Waalon Kee Chaahe Naak Sikud Jae

Kashmir Main Too Kanyakumari

Halake-phulke Packet Mein Dekho Mushkil Bhaaree

Kashmir Too Main Kanyakumari

Hindi Mein Gustaakhee Hai To English Mein Sorry

Chipak-chipak Ke Chalatee Hain Kabhi-kabhi Do Raahen

Jude-jude Kuch Aise Ki Lagaa Ho Jaise Gum

Double Double Hotee Thi Jo Kabhi-kabhi Taqalifein

Kisi Ke Sang Mein Chalne Se Huee Half Se Kam

Ho Tera-meraa Meraa-tera

Tera-mera Mera-tera Qissa Atarangi

Kabhi-kabhi Chalatee Hai

Kabhi-kabhi Rukati Kahaani Bedhangi

Kashmir Main Kashmir Main Too Kanyakumari

North South Kee Cat Gayi Dekho Doori Hee Saaree

Kashmir Tu Kashmir Tu Main Kanyakumari

50-50 Har Situation Mein Hissedari
